title: Quenched Butter Ukrainian Fish Stew
description: A buttery and energizing Ukrainian dish featuring lemon juice and miso-marinate, perfect for a cold evening. This pescatarian-friendly stew is cooked to perfection in a claypot.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, lemon juice, and 1 tablespoon of water to make the marinade.
Add the cod fillets to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in the claypot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth, salt, and black pepper to the claypot, then bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and add the marinated cod fillets to the claypot.
Simmer the stew, covered, for 10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until melted and well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, then serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill.
